symptomShortText: Thread stripping on M4 plastic boss detected by screwdriving angle-torque monitor

defect.defectText: Stripped plastic thread boss during automated screwdriving

inspections.measuredValue: Tightening torque = 3,2 Nm (over-torqued) (Vorgabe 1,8 +/- 0,2 Nm) - iO/niO: niO

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-7190, Shift B - changeover operator manually selected fastening Recipe B (metal housing 3.2 Nm) instead of Recipe A (thermoplastic boss 1.8 Nm) on HMI dropdown
DOC-5519 Rev B - work instruction lacked visual barcode confirmation requirement before starting screwdriving cycle
Torque-angle curve analyzer GA-0711 triggered torque-over-angle NOK alarm immediately

actions.actionText: 100% torque inspection on 62 assembled pump motors and replace stripped plastic housings
Implement 2D barcode scanner interlock on screwdriver controller to select recipe automatically from part label
Disable manual HMI program selection dropdown across all automated fastening stations in the plant

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: PMA-30 thermoplastic variants assembled on WC-ASSY-05 on 2026-08-07 afternoon shift
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: PMA-30 metal housing variants or assemblies produced on morning shift
isIsNot.notes: Defect caused exclusively by manual HMI recipe mismatch on plastic variant line run
